detail.longDescription: I am using proxy models in order to manage Users and groups? class User(AbstractUser): bio = models.TextField() def __str__(self): return self.first_name+' '+self.last_name class Author(Group): class Meta: proxy=True permissions=[("create_article","User can create article"),("edit_article","Edit Article")] class Publisher(Group): class Meta: proxy=True permissions=[("edit_article","Edit Article")] Is there a way to automatically create the nessesary migration in order once I change the permissions upon code also be changed into Db as well? My goal is somehow to have a config file with all permissions and a list that would define what permissions each groups would have. Then using this config file the django would check the user permissions.
